topic: fix a key that turns hard or sticks in a lock
core_question: Why is my key hard to turn in the lock, and how do I fix it? (secondary: How can I get through airport security more quickly?)
answer_summary: Apply powdered graphite (or a PTFE-based lock lubricant) into the keyway and work the key in and out to distribute it, freeing up a stiff cylinder.; after the topic shift: Wear slip-on shoes and minimal metal, place laptops and liquids in an easily accessible spot to pull out at the bin, and have your boarding pass and ID ready before reaching the checkpoint; consider enrolling in TSA PreCheck/Global Entry.
